description.value: King Kabob is a halal Persian grill restaurant on South Fraser Way in Abbotsford, billing itself as the first dedicated kabob house in the Fraser Valley. The menu centres on flame-broiled kebabs marinated with saffron, dried limes, and traditional Middle Eastern spices, served with basmati rice. The restaurant holds BCMA halal certification and offers both dine-in and online pickup/delivery ordering.
